name: PIMSY EHR & Billing
short_description: PIMSY is a mental health-specific EHR and billing platform designed for behavioral health and substance use treatment.
long_description: PIMSY (Psychiatric & Integrated Medical Software for You) is an EHR and billing platform specifically designed for mental health, behavioral health, and substance use disorder treatment practices. The system offers integrated electronic health records with psychiatric-specific documentation templates, scheduling, billing, and optional managed RCM services. PIMSY is built for the unique workflow needs of mental health providers and supports practices ranging from solo practitioners to large group practices and treatment facilities.
one_liner: Mental health-specific EHR and billing for behavioral health practices.
best_for: Mental health and behavioral health practices of all sizes
Psychiatric practices needing EHR + billing integration
Organizations wanting optional managed RCM services
